partitionExpressions.description:
List of {@link Expr} that defines how the table is partitioned.
Each expression must be a valid {@link Expr} that calculate a partition value from table's source value
Function supported in the expression is limited to the following: "day", "month", "year", "hour", "bucket"
For bucket partition,you need an additional parameter to specify the number of buckets.
e.g.
"day(t)" would partition table based on the day of column t (which must be a date/timestamp column)
"bucket(asset, 8)" would partition table based on the hash of column asset mod 8
